description:
In QBlade, generate a NACA 4415 airfoil using the built-in NACA generator. Then, modify this airfoil by applying a trailing edge flap deflection. Set the flap hinge position at 75% chord (0.75) and set the deflection angle to 10 degrees downward (positive). Finally, export two coordinate files in standard format (.dat):

1. The unmodified airfoil to: /home/ga/Documents/airfoils/naca4415_original.dat
2. The flap-deflected airfoil to: /home/ga/Documents/airfoils/naca4415_flap10.dat
